ValidationRule.description: The Recommended Actions field must have a value if "Continued Enrollment" is the type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordTypeId = '012d00000021xGK', RecordTypeId = '0126T000001QHKs' ), ISBLANK( Recommended_Actions__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status, 'Conferred with Student by Phone'), ISPICKVAL( Status, 'Conferred with Student by Email'), ISPICKVAL( Status, 'Conferred with Student via Zoom'), ISPICKVAL( Status, 'In Person Meeting') ) )
